description: Fatal first reply (MCPWARP.md §6A.6 G5): the first registered refuses every service (alpha CONFLICT, beta QUOTA_EXCEEDED), no service has been active since the connection started, and nothing is outstanding, so the group goes error/INTERNAL with lastError "No service could be registered." (no new TunnelStatusCode); the services keep their rejected entries. Like any error state it is final until the next configure: no redial during a long tick.

alpha.lastError: The name is in use by another server.

beta.lastError: Your mcpwarp account has no services left in its quota.
